proof_summary: For consecutive divisors \(a<b\), a break \(b>2a\) is equivalent to \(b\) being odd and satisfying \(b\ge 2a\): equality is impossible for odd \(b\), while if a breaking \(b\) were even, then \(b/2\) would be a divisor strictly between \(a\) and \(b\). Thus the two descriptions count the same breaks, and adding one counts the resulting maximal blocks.
